data.name: Merrily
data.long_meaning: The name Merrily is derived from the Old English word ‘mærele’ meaning ‘wondrous, marvelous’. This name was used to describe someone who was full of joy and happiness, often spreading cheer to those around them. In Christian tradition, this name is also associated with the virtues of faith and hope, reminding us to rejoice in the blessings of God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to find joy and happiness in the present moment, trusting in God's love and grace.
